content:
amanda: quick sync: need an actionable plan for precision artifact lifecycle + AB test strategy for FP8/INT8/4bit. can we lock interface boundaries, telemetry, and rollout steps by EOD tomorrow?

ravi: +1. main risk: profile combinatorics and customer overrides. how do we avoid explosion?

dylan: propose treating profiles as immutable artifacts (id + semver). runtime reads profile_id@semver. overrides are tiny delta layers applied at request time. keeps runtime atomic.

maria: for AB we should standardize telemetry: per-token perplexity-proxy, response-SNR proxy, p95 latency, token-regen-rate. lightweight but actionable.

kevin: add composite `degradation_score` we can compute online + offline. combine divergence proxy + QA-failure rate. threshold gating for rollbacks.

amanda: format/storage decision? human-readable vs compact runtime blob?

dylan: hybrid: YAML/JSON in git as source-of-truth; CI compiles to signed binary artifact used by runtime. include compat_signature in artifact.

sam: rollout: start with small customer cohorts, then global canary, then ramp. ops needs flexible sampling primitives.

maria: routing rules must be declarative and allow predicates: model, endpoint, customer_id, profile_version. e.g. route: { predicate: customer.in_beta, profile: p123@1.2.0 }

ravi: overrides: SDK flag + request header? precedence rules?

kevin: prefer SDK param `precision_hint` and header `X-Precision-Override` for manual experiments; header wins. ops will log both for attribution.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder: when rolling out new profiles, add `telemetry.degradation.*` counters to ingest pipeline.

sam: actions: 1) RFC for artifact lifecycle (dylan + amanda) 2) telemetry contract (kevin + maria) 3) routing & overrides API (ravi + sam) due EOD tomorrow.

amanda: i'll coordinate and loop in security/legal re: KMS/export requirements for compiled blobs. ping here with objections. :thumbsup:
